capabilities: Run Pomodoro work and break sessions with configurable durations
Show remaining time in the status bar and a sidebar countdown panel
Notify via OS notification and audio beep when a phase ends
Log completed sessions to a Markdown file with editable notes and wikilinks
Review session history with a weekly bar chart and all-time total
extras: Manual installation only (copy files into .obsidian/plugins); manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted to stay focused without exiting Obsidian to use a third-party timer, so they built the timer into the app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in focus timer, so users had to leave the app to run a Pomodoro timer, which breaks concentration.
summary: Minimal Pomodoro timer with a sidebar panel, status bar countdown, OS notifications, and session logging to a Markdown file.
